versions.name: Camp Meriwether

features.note: Land sailers and sandboards on two miles of private Pacific beach; the council bills it as unique to Meriwether.
A BMX pump track plus roughly two miles of coastal-rainforest trails.
A full-size replica of Lewis and Clark's winter fort, with costumed staff teaching blacksmithing, candle-making, and black-powder marksmanship.
Rover Camp forms a provisional troop with its own adult leadership, so a Scout can attend without their unit.

versions.summary: Oceanfront resident camp on the Oregon coast featuring a waterfront with sailing, surfing, and scuba, plus shooting sports, climbing, COPE, and a dining hall. Offers a dedicated older-Scout program with high-adventure options.
